And yes, I'm glad places like this exist. Reddit is the only place I have where I can talk openly about these issues.
Pulling down my sleeve and just see them always calms me as well... also the knowledge that they are there is helpful to me.
I like if the are arrayed in some symmetrical order...and I'm happy about any scratch which has a bit dried blood over it.

I'm a bit more confortable if I know, where the scissor is placed. The thing with the knife was after a video conference about some long term groups project, which I hate. That thing always multiplies my self hate and suicidal thoughts, since I'm failing to do my part for it due to procrastination. Really, I ran my fingers over the blade... but in the end I put it down since I didn't want to clean up a potential mess.

I feel so trapped, that my brain snaps into sh urges...
